title: Problem Space
summary: An unfinished, repo-backed PWA for mapping problems as recursive nodes with explained cross-domain relationships and a device-local thought inbox.
epitaph: The atlas was ready. The first problem never arrived.

related.reason: Purpose → Plan → Result could provide a compact framing prompt inside each problem node, while the atlas preserves decomposition and cross-problem links.
